newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Northwest Air Q1 EPS cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Northwest Air Q1 EPS cut.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co Inc said Thursday it lowered its earnings per share projections on Northwest Airlines Corp to $0.40 from $0.80 for Q1 and to $5.50 from $6.50 for the full year. It said the action reflects the shift in the value of the yen and competitive impact of the AMR Corp "non-strike."
-- Gruntal in a report also said it maintains its outperform (speculative) rating for Northwest Airlines.
-- Northwest Airlines was trading down 1/8 at 35-3/8.
